```{r libraries}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(googlesheets4)
library(testthat)
```

```{r auth}
gs4_auth(Sys.getenv("email"))
```

```{r read raw data}
nestkast_hist_raw <- read_sheet("16S2cMLTbuIQt8P3yyNshAx4bHUxC_8KNDKUQXmrGM8Q")
```

```{r read app data}
dd_nestkast_type <- read_sheet("1_JZRcird23bYOfYZo0cz1M78gTGitJP83-7rAQaax5k",
                               sheet = "dd_nestkast_type")
```

```{r mapping: prep}
nestkast_hist <- nestkast_hist_raw %>% 
  rename(nestkast_label = nestkast_ID,
         nestkast_type_beschrijving = ...2,
         opmerkingen_nestkast_hist = opmerkingen) %>% 
  left_join(dd_nestkast_type, by = "nestkast_type_beschrijving")

missing_nestkast_types <- nestkast_hist %>% 
  filter(is.na(nestkast_type_label)) %>% 
  distinct(nestkast_type_beschrijving)

test_that("Check for missing nestkast types", {
  
  # Calculate the number of missing types
  num_missing <- nrow(missing_nestkast_types)
  
  # Create a descriptive string of the missing types to display if the test fails
  missing_list <- paste(missing_nestkast_types$nestkast_type_beschrijving, collapse = ", ")
  
  # The test: we expect num_missing to be 0
  expect_equal(num_missing, 0, 
               info = paste("Missing nestkast_type_beschrijving found:", missing_list, 
               "\n add these to the nestkast types view in the app and rerun"))
})
```

```{r mapping: base}
nestkast_hist_base_int <- nestkast_hist %>% 
  select(nestkast_label, nestkast_type_id, opmerkingen_nestkast_hist, Lambert_x, Lambert_y) %>% 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Lambert_x", "Lambert_y"),
           crs = fistools::CRS_extracter("bel")) %>% 
  st_transform(fistools::CRS_extracter("wgs")) %>% 
  mutate(nestkast_hist_lat = st_coordinates(.)[,2],
         nestkast_hist_lng = st_coordinates(.)[,1],
         nestkast_hist_coordinaten = paste(nestkast_hist_lat, nestkast_hist_lng, sep = ", "))

nestkast_hist_base <- nestkast_hist_base_int %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()
```

```{r test spatial, eval=FALSE}
library(leaflet)

leaflet() %>% 
  addTiles() %>% 
  addCircles(data = nestkast_hist_base_int)
```

```{r mapping: plaatsing}
nestkast_hist_plaatsing <- nestkast_hist %>% 
  mutate(ophangdatum = as.character(ophangdatum)) %>% 
  select(nestkast_label, ophangdatum) %>% 
  mutate(nestkast_hist_datumtijd = case_when(is.null(ophangdatum) ~ NA,
                                             ophangdatum == "zomer 2024" ~ "01-07-2024",
                                             ophangdatum == "2-11/6/25" ~ "06-06-2025",
                                             ophangdatum == "1760313600" ~ as.character(as.Date.numeric(as.numeric(ophangdatum))),
                                             TRUE ~ ophangdatum)
         )

table(nestkast_hist_plaatsing$ophangdatum, nestkast_hist_plaatsing$nestkast_hist_datumtijd, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r mapping: controles}
nestkast_hist_controles <- nestkast_hist %>% 
  select(nestkast_label, contains("controle"))
```

```{r mapping: opruim}
nestkast_hist_opruim <- nestkast_hist %>% 
  select(nestkast_label, verwijderdatum)
```
